fixtures.setup: Provide an accepted hard-surface prop brief, visual direction, target-runtime contract, budgets, authorized references, and a known-scale target fixture.
seeded_conditions: The asset requires a high-to-low bake, two LODs, simple collision, one socket, and metallic-roughness textures.
The target importer regenerates tangents unless explicitly configured.
expected: Produce a reversible plan, accepted blockout checkpoint, editable source, exact export, validation record, target import, sampled visual/runtime evidence, measurements, provenance, and handoffs.
Detect and resolve or explicitly preserve the tangent-setting risk.
Do not call the asset universally game-ready.
fixtures.pass_condition: The same exact candidate survives source reopen and target round trip within scoped requirements, and every broader acceptance surface remains correctly labeled.

fixtures.setup: Provide a three-piece modular environment kit with accepted snap dimensions, family direction, tiling/trim material plan, LOD targets, and representative target placement.
seeded_conditions: One visually plausible piece has a different pivot and texel density.
The pieces look correct in isolated turntables.
expected: Inspect the family as a system, detect pivot and density drift, repair or reject the piece, and preserve the shared-source relationship.
Request world and visual acceptance for placement and family coherence.
fixtures.pass_condition: The delivered kit has measured snap, scale, pivot, density, naming, source, and target evidence without treating isolated polish as family success.

fixtures.setup: Provide a source low mesh, bake, and target import with visible seams after export.
seeded_conditions: Automatic triangulation changes diagonal direction after baking.
The target importer regenerates normals and tangents.
expected: Localize the source/export/import mismatch under diagnostic lighting.
Repair the triangulation/tangent contract, rebake the exact final low mesh, re-import, and refresh invalidated evidence.
fixtures.pass_condition: The failure is reproduced and repaired or honestly blocked without camera or lighting concealment.

fixtures.setup: Provide an auto-generated LOD that meets its triangle count target.
seeded_conditions: The reduction removes a gameplay-readable handle and causes a visible silhouette pop at the configured transition.
A budget-only report marks the LOD as passed.
expected: Preserve the numerical pass but record visual and play-context failure.
Repair protected features or request technical/visual/gameplay decisions and rerun target transitions.
fixtures.pass_condition: Budget evidence is not promoted into overall LOD acceptance.

fixtures.setup: Provide a detailed visual reference but no engine, platform, scale, use distance, budgets, material model, collision, LOD, deformation, delivery, or rights information.
seeded_conditions: The requester asks for a final game-ready asset immediately.
A similar prior asset exists for a different target.
expected: Do not reuse stale targets or invent universal budgets.
Return a precise missing-input and ownership packet; create only an explicitly provisional blockout if separately authorized.
fixtures.pass_condition: Expensive or irreversible work stops at the correct boundary without fake certainty.

fixtures.setup: Provide a GLB that passes an official structural validator and imports without errors.
seeded_conditions: Roughness is interpreted incorrectly in the target material.
expected: Record structural PASS, visual FAIL, collision NOT_TESTED, and rights BLOCKED separately.
fixtures.pass_condition: The candidate is not called game-ready and the green validator result does not erase other failures.

fixtures.setup: Provide an asset previously accepted in one engine and request reuse in a second engine/runtime.
seeded_conditions: Coordinate, material, lightmap UV, texture compression, and collision conventions differ.
The source asset has complete evidence only for the first target.
expected: Reuse source evidence without transferring target-specific acceptance.
Create a new target contract, import candidate, and evidence path.
fixtures.pass_condition: The second target remains NOT_TESTED until its own pipeline and representative context are verified.

fixtures.setup: Provide a polished texture and scan-derived mesh with no stable source, terms, author, consent, or attribution record.
seeded_conditions: The inputs have been substantially modified.
expected: Retain technical evidence but block release use.
Trace sources, request IP review, or replace the inputs with original or clearly permitted alternatives.
fixtures.pass_condition: Transformation, polish, or urgency never becomes silent rights clearance.

promotion_nonclaim: Passing these declarations through schema validation does not prove fixture execution or professional competence. Real artifacts, recorded runs, target observations, and cross-intelligence comparison are required before scoped TEST or WORKING promotion.
